info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Corporate Partnerships Management API
info.description: The Corporate Partnerships Management API allows businesses to update and modify existing partnerships with corporate entities. This API facilitates the management of terms and conditions, partnership statuses, and other related attributes to enhance collaboration. Typical consumers include corporate relationship managers and business development teams looking to optimize their partnerships. Use cases include updating partnership agreements to reflect new terms or adjusting the scope of collaboration based on evolving business needs.

patch.description: This operation allows developers to update the details of a specific corporate partnership identified by its unique resource ID. Make sure to provide the necessary data in the request body to successfully amend the partnership's information.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update details of the corporate partnership identified by RES-100045. The provided JSON object must include all necessary fields to represent the updated state of the partnership. Ensure that the data is accurately formatted to avoid validation errors.
